title: mail-server: Email/set blobId/size sentinel
description: Follow-up from JMAP-dpbp (id sentinel removed). Email/set create still builds the Email with blob_id = "placeholder-blob" (helpers::PLACEHOLDER_BLOB_ID) and size = 0, and MailBackend::create_object / MemoryBackend replace them (memory/mod.rs create_object; email.rs build_email_from_create; backend.rs '# Email server-set fields'). Same in-band pattern JMAP-dpbp removed for id. RFC 8621 §4.1.1 blobId/size are server-set and describe the stored RFC 5322 message, so the fix belongs with jmap-mime message construction (JMAP-wgbh): the handler or backend builds the message bytes, stores the blob, and builds the Email with real blobId/size. Options: (a) builder takes (id, blob_id, size) from the backend; (b) a separate create_email backend method that receives the validated create and returns the stored Email. Recommendation: (b), like import_email.
notes:
DECISION Mark 2026-10-23: option (A). Add an RFC 5322 composer to jmap-mime (address headers, Subject, Message-ID, In-Reply-To, References, Date from sentAt/receivedAt, MIME-Version, RFC 2047 for non-ASCII headers, multipart from textBody/htmlBody/attachments or bodyStructure, bodyValues as QP or base64, blobId parts fetched from the backend). Add MailBackend::create_email that stores the blob, mints ids and stores the Email atomically; the handler builds the Email by parsing the composed bytes (same path as import), which also stores from/to/cc/bcc/sender/replyTo/messageId/body fields. Remove PLACEHOLDER_BLOB_ID and the memory-backend replacement code. BREAKING for MailBackend implementers. Two commits: jmap-mime compose, then mail-server create_email. Tests against hand-written RFC 5322 output.
DECISION Mark 2026-10-23 (placement): put the RFC 5322/MIME writer in jmap-mime now. Keep the generic writer in its own module with no JMAP types in its API (the JMAP Email-create mapping in a separate module), so it can later move to mime-tree (see follow-up bead).
